lines.t: Do not place your trust in any man,
Nor lean upon the pride of man’s invention,
For the things of this world will deceive you—
Beloved, turn your heart, find true ascension.
Turn away from the doctrine of men,
Stand apart from all this poison and lies.
Close your eyes to the screen’s bright illusions,
Shut your ears to the world’s mocking cries.
Separate, beloved, from the noise and the show,
Find your refuge where true waters flow.
Do not follow the teachings made by hands,
Nor walk the paths of transient ideology.
The commands of men lead only to bondage,
Break free, beloved, live eternally.
Turn away from the doctrine of men,
Stand apart from all this poison and lies.
Close your eyes to the screen’s bright illusions,
Shut your ears to the world’s mocking cries.
Separate, beloved, from the noise and the show,
Find your refuge where true waters flow.
Beloved, hear the call beyond the veil,
Leave behind what fades and deceives.
In silence and truth your spirit will heal—
In God’s pure Word your soul believes.
Turn away from the doctrine of men,
Stand apart from all this poison and lies.
Close your eyes to the screen’s bright illusions,
Shut your ears to the world’s mocking cries.
Separate, beloved, from the noise and the show,
Find your refuge where true waters flow.
Turn your trust to the One who is true,
Lean not on man, but on Heaven’s view.
Beloved, stand firm, apart and free—
In the truth of God alone, be free.
